# KOG Roofing

> Roofing contractor based in Granbury, Texas, roofing homes and commercial buildings across the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex since 2010. Roof repair and replacement on shingle, metal, TPO, EPDM, and torch-down roofs, plus seamless gutters, storm damage inspections, and 24-hour emergency tarping.

- Phone (call or text): (817) 550-2339
- Email: office@kogroofs.com
- Website: https://kogroofs.com
- Hours: 7 AM to 7 PM, Monday through Saturday. Texts and online requests during those hours are answered within an hour. Emergency tarping is available 24 hours.
- Service area: 14 counties around Dallas-Fort Worth: Tarrant, Dallas, Collin, Denton, Johnson, Parker, Ellis, Hood, Wise, Rockwall, Erath, Somervell, Kaufman, and Hunt.
- Inspections are free and come with a written report and photos. Every job gets a written price before work starts.
- Inspection requests go to KOG only. KOG never sells or shares them.
- KOG posts its price ranges publicly (updated October 2026): roof repairs $75 to $1,500 depending on the repair; architectural shingle replacement $500 to $750 per square (100 sq ft), about $10,000 to $15,000 for a typical 20-square roof before extras; metal $645 to $860 per square (exposed-fastener) and $995 to $1,325 per square (standing seam); seamless gutters $5.50 to $10 per foot; commercial TPO about $7 to $10 per square foot. These are typical ranges, not quotes.
- On insurance claims, the homeowner works with their own insurance company. KOG provides inspection reports and photos and does not act as anyone's adjuster.
- Payment: cash, check, credit and debit cards, Zelle, Bitcoin, and other cryptocurrency.
- Reviews: https://www.facebook.com/kogroofing (Facebook) and https://www.bbb.org/us/tx/granbury/profile/roofing-equipment/kog-roofing-0825-235975787 (Better Business Bureau). Nextdoor: https://nextdoor.com/page/kog-roofing-granbury-tx-fnl9q6

- [Is a Metal Roof Worth It? Types, Costs, and Hail](https://kogroofs.com/metal-roof-guide.html): Standing seam versus exposed-fastener metal roofs, what you're paying for, gauge and paint finishes, and how hail and insurance affect metal roofing.
- [Why Texas Roofs Die Early: Attic Ventilation](https://kogroofs.com/attic-ventilation.html): How soffit intake and ridge exhaust keep a Texas attic from cooking your shingles from underneath, what the building code asks for, the mistakes we find most, and how they're fixed.
- [How Long Do I Have to File a Hail Claim in Texas?](https://kogroofs.com/hail-claim-deadline.html): Many Texas policies give you one year from a storm to report roof damage. The deadlines on a hail claim, how to find your storm date, and why waiting costs you.
- [Can My Insurance Drop Me Because My Roof Is Old? Texas 2026](https://kogroofs.com/old-roof-insurance.html): In Texas, an insurer can't deny or refuse to renew your home policy because of your roof's age alone. What they can still do, and what to do if you get a letter about your roof.
- [Will a Roof Claim Raise My Insurance Rates in Texas?](https://kogroofs.com/roof-claim-rates.html): Texas limits how insurers can use hail and wind claims against you. What can and can't raise your premium, and what to ask your agent before you file a roof claim.
- [Do I Have to Use My Insurance Company's Roofer? Texas](https://kogroofs.com/choose-your-own-roofer.html): No. In Texas, you choose who repairs your home on an insurance claim. What that means for your claim, your check, and your deductible, and how to pick a roofer you can trust.
- [Only Part of My Roof Is Damaged. Will Insurance Replace All of It?](https://kogroofs.com/partial-roof-claim.html): Texas insurers don't have to replace a whole roof just because new shingles won't match. What decides it, what to check in your policy, and how to make a partial repair look its best.
- [Should I Sign Anything Before the Insurance Adjuster Comes?](https://kogroofs.com/sign-before-adjuster.html): You don't have to sign anything to get your roof inspected or file a claim. What to read for if a roofer hands you papers before the adjuster comes, and what Texas law says.
- [Do Roofers Need a License in Texas? What to Check Instead](https://kogroofs.com/texas-roofer-license.html): Texas doesn't license roofing contractors. What that means for you, which cities require registration and permits, and the six things to check before you hire a roofer.
- [How to Choose a Roofer You Can Trust in Dallas-Fort Worth](https://kogroofs.com/how-to-choose-a-roofer.html): Ten questions to ask any roofer, the red flags that matter most after a Texas hailstorm, and how to compare roofers when the quotes don't line up.

- [Does a New Roof Add Value to My Home or Help It Sell?](https://kogroofs.com/new-roof-home-value.html): An asphalt roof replacement recoups about two-thirds of its cost at resale. Where a sound roof really pays is in getting the house sold. What to do with your roof before you list.
- [What's the Best Shingle for Texas Heat and Hail?](https://kogroofs.com/best-shingles-texas.html): For most North Texas homes, a Class 4 impact-resistant shingle over an attic that breathes. Why not every Class 4 shingle is equal, how the Texas insurance discount works, and when to look at metal.
- [Water Stain on the Ceiling? Is It a Big Deal?](https://kogroofs.com/ceiling-water-stain.html): A small brown stain on the ceiling usually means water got in. How to tell if it's the roof, the AC line, or plumbing, what to do this week, and why waiting costs more.
